rule.rule_text: Before calling book_appointment or rescheduling, read back the single chosen slot with provider, day, date and time, and ask the patient to confirm. Only book after they say yes to that exact read-back, even if they already said 'book it'. If they change their choice, read back the new slot and ask again.
rule.rationale: In every failing conversation the assistant booked straight after the patient picked from a list of several times (or said 'the first one'), without a single-slot read-back and an affirmative reply. In one case it booked before the patient confirmed and then changed the booking. Requiring an explicit read-back of one slot followed by a yes closes the gap. It also resolves ambiguous picks like 'the first one' when two doctors share a time.
rule.risk: Adds one extra turn per booking, which may feel redundant to patients who were already explicit. Cancellations bundled with reschedules might also be held until after confirmation. In race conditions it could add a second confirmation loop after a slot-taken error.
